harbor_antrieb_executor.summary: Deployed PostgreSQL 14 streaming replication across node1 (originally primary), node2, and node3 (standbys). Simulated primary loss by stopping PostgreSQL on node1, promoted node2 to writable primary with zero data loss, repointed node3 to stream from node2, and rejoined node1 as a standby of node2 via fresh pg_basebackup. Verified writes on node2 replicate to both standbys. Completed the mandatory node-restart evidence protocol: rebooted node1, node3, then node2 (the current primary) one at a time via `systemctl reboot`, confirming boot_id changes and full replication/data recovery after each, preserving quorum throughout.
actions_performed: Installed PGDG repo and PostgreSQL 14 server/contrib packages on node1, node2, node3 (RHEL7; PG10-13/15 repos were 410 Gone or missing libzstd, PG14 was the working option)
Populated /etc/hosts with CLUSTER_HOSTS on all nodes
Initialized primary DB on node1, configured wal_level=replica, max_wal_senders, hot_standby, pg_hba.conf replication entries, opened firewalld postgresql service
Created replicator role (password via secret_env) and appdb.ledger demo table with baseline committed row on node1
Ran pg_basebackup -R from node1 to build node2 and node3 as streaming standbys; verified pg_stat_replication and data presence
Inserted a pre-failover committed row and confirmed it replicated to both standbys before disruption
Stopped postgresql-14 on node1 to simulate primary loss
Promoted node2 via pg_ctl promote; verified zero data loss and wrote new row as new primary
Opened firewalld postgresql service on node2; repointed node3's primary_conninfo to node2 and restarted; verified streaming and data catch-up
Rebuilt node1 via pg_basebackup -R from node2 and started it as a standby of the new primary; verified full data catch-up and 2-standby streaming state on node2
Captured baseline boot_id and PG health on all 3 nodes
Rebooted node1 via systemctl reboot, polled until reachable, confirmed changed boot_id, verified postgresql-14 active, standby recovery, and data intact, and reconnection to node2's replication view
Rebooted node3 via systemctl reboot, polled until reachable, confirmed changed boot_id, verified standby recovery, data intact, and reconnection to node2
Rebooted node2 (primary) last via systemctl reboot, polled until reachable, confirmed changed boot_id, verified it resumed as primary with both standbys reconnected and data intact
Performed a final write on node2 and confirmed replication to node1 and node3 post-restart

evidence.requirement: 3-node streaming replication established, node1 primary / node2+node3 standbys
evidence.summary: pg_stat_replication on node1 shows both node2 and node3 streaming; pg_is_in_recovery=true on both standbys with baseline data present

evidence.requirement: Committed data survives primary loss (no data loss on failover)
evidence.summary: Row 'committed-before-failover' inserted on node1 and confirmed replicated to node2/node3 before node1 was stopped; after promotion, node2 (new primary) still shows the row intact

evidence.requirement: Standby (node2) promotes to writable primary on primary loss
evidence.summary: pg_ctl promote on node2 completed; pg_is_in_recovery()=false; new write accepted on node2

evidence.requirement: Surviving standby (node3) re-targets to new primary
evidence.summary: node3 primary_conninfo repointed to node2, restarted, pg_stat_replication on node2 shows node3 streaming, and node3 has the new post-promotion row

evidence.requirement: Recovered former primary (node1) rejoins as standby of current primary (node2)
evidence.summary: node1 rebuilt via pg_basebackup from node2, started as standby (pg_is_in_recovery=true), full ledger data present, and subsequent node2 write replicated to node1

evidence.requirement: node1 restart: healthy baseline, restart ack, changed boot identity, recovered state
evidence.summary: Baseline boot_id 9ed9e820...; systemctl reboot acked via connection-closed; post-reboot boot_id e12c6e69... (changed); postgresql-14 active, standby recovered with all 4 rows, node2 shows node1 reconnected streaming

evidence.requirement: node3 restart: healthy baseline, restart ack, changed boot identity, recovered state
evidence.summary: Baseline boot_id c8eba47a...; reboot acked; post-reboot boot_id 1ddd47ff... (changed); postgresql-14 active, standby recovered with all 4 rows, node2 shows node3 reconnected streaming

evidence.requirement: node2 (primary) restart: healthy baseline, restart ack, changed boot identity, recovered state with quorum preserved
evidence.summary: Baseline boot_id 4326d5b8... with both standbys streaming; reboot acked; post-reboot boot_id f7e960c9... (changed); postgresql-14 active, still primary (pg_is_in_recovery=false), both node1 and node3 reconnected streaming, 4 rows intact

evidence.requirement: Post-restart end-to-end write/replication integrity across full cluster
evidence.summary: New row written on node2 after all three restarts, confirmed present on both node1 and node3 (5 rows total, matching)
